dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: Ah, what did you say again? My ears aren't that good... Oh, you mean the Naganohara Fireworks Show, right?

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: We can't talk about Fireworks Show without mentioning fireworks. A long time ago...
